ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT and reconnaissance dashboard designed for CTF competitors to map out web endpoints, leaked logs, and assets instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Fragments to Fortress: Web exploitation, cryptography, forensics, steganography, OSINT and reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.title: FortressMap: Automated Attack Surface and OSINT Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence and rapid visualization techniques similar to GraphGuard to help competitors systematically analyze attack surfaces without triggering platform bans.

ideas.pitch: A secure, client-side encrypted collaboration scratchpad for CTF teams to share code snippets, keys, and decryption parameters securely.
ideas.problem_statement: Fragments to Fortress: Jeopardy-style contest where teams solve challenges across cryptography, forensics, and reverse engineering.
ideas.title: CryptPad: Zero-Knowledge Secret Sharing Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies zero-knowledge or advanced cryptographic primitives to ensure team collaboration security, reflecting the deep cryptography themes of the CTF.

ideas.pitch: A forensic analysis toolkit that rapidly scans images, packet captures, and binary logs for hidden steganographic payloads and anomalies.
ideas.problem_statement: Fragments to Fortress: Jeopardy-style contest involving forensics, steganography, and reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.title: StegoAudit: Automated Forensics & Hidden Data Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering algorithms for file structure parsing and automated heuristic detection of hidden data payloads.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local proxy that intercepts and sanitizes web requests and flags potential injection attempts in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Fragments to Fortress: Web exploitation and reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.title: DefensiveGuard: Prompt-Injection & Web Payload Hardening Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies defense-in-depth and payload hardening principles seen in winning agent security projects, translating defensive concepts into a practical tool.

ideas.pitch: A localized real-time flag management platform for tracking solved categories, team progress, and vulnerability vectors.
ideas.problem_statement: Fragments to Fortress: Each solved challenge gives you a flag, and each flag brings you closer to rebuilding the fortress.
ideas.title: FlagVault: Cryptographic Flag Validation and Scoring Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides extremely clean execution and robust state management for competitive environments, aligning with the core premise of tracking multi-vector CTF flags.
